findings.quoted_text: Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: If the client terminates the contract for convenience, you will not be paid for any work that is currently in progress, meaning you could perform services without receiving compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Client will pay Contractor for all Services performed and Deliverables in progress up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership transfers to the client after only the first milestone payment, leaving subsequent work unprotected before you are paid in full.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverables, the Client owns all rights in such Deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a few adjustments before signing:

- Regarding the clause stating that fees for services in progress at termination are not payable, this means I might not be paid for work already underway if the contract ends early. I propose changing this so that the client pays for all services performed and deliverables in progress up to the termination date.
- Regarding the clause about intellectual property transferring upon payment of the first milestone invoice, this assigns ownership before subsequent work is fully paid for. I propose that the client owns the rights to applicable deliverables only upon receipt of full payment for them.

Thank you for considering these updates. I look forward to moving forward.

Best regards
